name: 02145 · Somerville, MA
findings: ZIP 02145 (Somerville) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02145 (Somerville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02145 (Somerville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
